title: Seasonal-naive EZ HICP print-deviation late-window drift on EURUSD (vintaged first prints, v2-day PIT-gated entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for THIS cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned P0 censuses/gate (p0c wide-window census, EURUSD integrity census, spot pin manifest, p0_gate) and the frozen cross-cycle failure inventory (research/wayfinder/FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl + ng2/ng3 terminal reports) was consumed.

mechanism.story: The public's zero-cost expectation proxy for next month's Euro-area HICP index is the publicly computable seasonal-naive continuation of the vintaged index: apply last year's same-month seasonal ratio to the latest vintaged level. An EZ first print that deviates from that continuation is EZ inflation NEWS relative to the adaptive-expectations anchor that households, corporates and slow real money actually use.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) adaptive-expectation agents anchor on naive continuations and reprice the ECB policy path only gradually when the print breaks the continuation; (ii) benchmark/tracking books and calendar-fixing corporate hedgers rebalance on scheduled windows after the repricing; (iii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: entry is gated at the v2 availability day -- the earliest instant at which BOTH the first-print value AND its first-print identity (the v1->v2 version gap that defines a restricted event under the ng2/ng3 standard) are PIT-provable from the evidenced archive. On this feed that instant is weeks-to-years after publication (20 of the 37 events belong to the 2015-03..2017-11 publication cohort whose v2 availability days land inside S0). The hypothesis is that seasonal-shape deviation repricing survives the PIT-provable availability lag plus the holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_ez_economy_info_is_new: The EZ economy was NEVER anchored in program history: V6/V7 books were GB/CA (+cross-pair), V8/V9 forms were US-inflation/nominal-yield constructions, ng1 print-deviation ran on GB/CA/AU/NZ/US, and ng2/ng3 revision dynamics ran on CA/GB/AU/NZ/US -- no EZ conditioning variable and no EURUSD leg exists anywhere in the inventory. EURUSD is the deepest FX pair, the ECB path responds to EZ HICP, and this cycle is the first with a pinned vintaged EZ feed (CP0000EZ19M086NEST wide-window true vintages) plus P0-pinned EURUSD spot on the frozen 16:00-NY plane. P1 conditions on the within-year SEASONAL shape (month-to-month seasonal ratio); P2 conditions on the 12-month TREND level -- different surprise constructions, not re-parameterizations.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (expectancy <= 0 after costs) if the late window is efficient, i.e. deviation repricing completes well before the v2 availability day. It must die by falsification if the identical book is reproduced by the sign-only release-reaction form (CTL-V7RECAP, the plan sec1 MANDATORY control because EZ prints are reaction forms), by a nominal-yield-level exposure (V8 law), by a clock-only shadow, or by a non-print-day placebo. It dies at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full failure inventory -- INCLUDING the dead ng1 print-deviation/acceleration books (the same FORM on GB/CA/AU/NZ/US, falsified cluster #15): a new-economy re-clock of a dead form dies at D2, accepted in advance (plan sec1 law).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: realized vintaged EZ HICP first-print index levels (CP0000EZ19M086NEST, p0c wide-window true-vintage archive) vs a frozen seasonal-naive predictor computed from the same vintaged archive; NO consensus/forecast data anywhere.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor: I_hat_sn(m) = I(m-1) * ( I(m-12) / I(m-13) ), where I(k) is the vintaged EZ HICP index level for calendar month k in the vintage in force at the decision instant (point-in-time read of the vintaged series, never a later revision).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor_name: seasonal-naive one-step (last-year same-month seasonal ratio applied to the latest vintaged level)
information_source_and_surprise_construc.surprise: s1 = 100 * ( I_print(m) / I_hat_sn(m) - 1 ), in percentage points of index deviation.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.i_print_source: the FIRST-PRINT (v1) value of obs month m: the index value carried by the archive version whose realtime window opened at the v1 availability day (date-only evidence). This is the value as first carried by the evidenced vintaged channel; the Eurostat flash-estimate feed is NOT represented and NOT claimed (declared identity, ng1 channel law).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.pit_rule: All predictor inputs I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) are calendar months relative to the obs month m, read as-of the decision instant D(e) in the vintage in force then. I_print is the frozen v1 value, knowable at D(e) because v1 day < D(e). No value that entered its vintage after D(e) may be read (P-1..P-6 chain; ONE_EVENT_LAG impossible by construction). DECLARED ASYMMETRY: the surprise deliberately compares a frozen historical first print against the predictor recomputable from the vintaged state at D(e) -- for the long-lag cohort events (v2 years after v1) the baseline months may carry later revisions; that mixing IS the frozen PIT-honest identity.

frozen_parameters.neighbour_parameterization: rolling-MAD normalized: z1 = s1 / MAD24, MAD24 = 1.4826 * median(|s1,k - median(s1)|) over the EZ stream's prior first-release surprises, expanding window, minimum 8 prior surprises required to fire; fire iff |z1| >= 1.0; holding 5 grid days
frozen_parameters.threshold_selection_basis: blind frozen priors chosen before any outcome (family convention carried from the ng1 A4 forms); no tuning permitted after any number is seen (P-15)

EZ.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long EUR vs USD

universe.direction_law: s1 >= +threshold => long EUR vs USD (long EURUSD): an EZ inflation print above the naive seasonal continuation reprices the ECB path hawkish. s1 <= -threshold => the mirror (short EURUSD). |s1| < threshold => no position. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias in the anchor.

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed_MANDATORY: V7 closed the reaction-direction class (sign-of-release continuation, both sides of the economy boundary; V7-A4-P1 additionally died by falsification-by-control #12 -- the +7d sham reproduced it). Plan sec1 declares EZ prints are reaction forms, making the V7-ancestry falsification control MANDATORY on this lane; carried as CTL-V7RECAP (sign-only, no magnitude gate, every event fires). This lane differs structurally: (i) conditioning is a magnitude-bearing deviation vs a frozen naive predictor, NOT the sign of the release; (ii) entry is strictly after the v2 availability day (weeks-to-years after publication), a horizon V6/V7 never represented; (iii) two-sided thresholded, no static direction. The distinction is ALSO measured, twice: CTL-V7RECAP kill at >= 0.5x same-sign per-trade, and D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the full inventory including both V7 books; over the bar => lane dies at D2 (accepted in advance).

D2 measures it.
